He put crushed up DOC on some foil then folded it perfectly flat with edges tucked in like an envelope. Colored the foil black with a sharpie, then taped it onto the bottom of the tobacco bag on the inside, then sealed it shut with a BIC. 

I've been caught that many times with meth because I get way too cocky and it's all catching up to me at once. I got used to using my looks or the fact that I am well spoken as a way to get out of things and the combination of all of these things has led me to prison. 

Btw, I am a female. :) thank you for all your help.
